plan.title: bug(costs): 'UNKNOWN' issue bucket dominates Costs by Issue ($12.7k of $16.7k) + per-issue total shows $0.00 while model rows sum higher + codex-harness cost misattribution
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

references.label: PRD draft with verified root causes

narratives.Problem: Three defects on the Cost Tracking surfaces: (1) the reconciler labels every unmappable session 'UNKNOWN', so a $12.8k UNKNOWN bucket (49,453 events — conversations, the flywheel-orchestrator conversation, oversight sessions) tops Costs by Issue; (2) GET /api/issues/:id/costs reads the legacy JSONL cache while the Costs page reads overdeck.db — two planes for one fact, so issue-level totals can show $0.00 while model rows sum higher; (3) the 'gpt-5.4-mini $0' rows are memory-extraction events priced by a stub pricing table in src/lib/memory/providers/types.ts, AND real codex-harness spend is missing entirely because nothing ever calls CostWriter.reconcile({source:'codex'}).
narratives.Proposal: Add a no-issue attribution classifier (CONVERSATIONS / FLYWHEEL / UNATTRIBUTED buckets stored in the issue_id column) used at reconciler ingest plus an idempotent backfill for existing UNKNOWN rows; unify /api/issues/:id/costs onto the overdeck read plane (getCostForIssueAggregateSync + new providers rollup); replace the memory-extraction stub pricing with the shared getPricingSync table; wire the codex sweep into the periodic cost-reconcile service with update-on-growth semantics for cumulative rollout totals; prove the codex path with a real gpt-5.5 rollout fixture; map bucket ids to neutral display labels in the frontend.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not modify the legacy plane (src/lib/costs/aggregator.ts, migration.ts, cache.json) beyond removing the /api/issues/:id/costs dependency on it; its 'UNKNOWN' fallbacks stay as-is.
- Do not split flywheel spend per RUN-id (single FLYWHEEL bucket; per-run split is a possible follow-up issue).
- Do not reclassify non-issue issue_ids other than the literal 'UNKNOWN' (e.g. rows already labeled 'sequencer-runner' stay).
- Do not alias codex-auto-review side threads to gpt-5.5 pricing; they stay at their real model id and computed ($0) cost.
- Do not add a per-issue budget setter or resurrect the dead legacy budget field on /api/issues/:id/costs.
- Do not rewrite events.jsonl archives; the backfill touches only the overdeck.db cache.
- Do not sweep codex sessions outside ~/.overdeck/agents/*/codex-home/sessions (e.g. a user's personal ~/.codex).

autoDecisions.summary: Buckets CONVERSATIONS/FLYWHEEL/UNATTRIBUTED are reserved uppercase ids stored in the existing issue_id column; display labels are a frontend mapping.
autoDecisions.rationale: No schema migration, all existing group-by-issue queries and drill surfaces work unchanged, and the acceptance ('named, neutral buckets, broken out') is met with three buckets.

autoDecisions.summary: Flywheel spend lands in one FLYWHEEL bucket rather than per-RUN-id.
autoDecisions.rationale: RUN-id ↔ session mapping is not reliably derivable from stored data (flywheel is one long-lived conversation across runs); a wrong per-run split is worse than an honest single bucket.

autoDecisions.summary: Bug 2 is fixed by unifying GET /api/issues/:id/costs onto the overdeck plane instead of chasing the transient $0 repro.
autoDecisions.rationale: Live verification showed both planes currently agree for PAN-2383 ($15.25); the defect is intermittent by construction (legacy cache miss => totalCost 0 at routes/issues.ts:713). Single-source-of-truth removes the disagreement class permanently.

autoDecisions.summary: The 'gpt-5.4-mini $0 calls=4' drill rows were re-diagnosed as memory-extraction events (stub pricing), not codex misattribution; both that stub AND the never-invoked codex sweep are fixed.
autoDecisions.rationale: DB evidence: those rows have sessionType='memory-extraction' and source='memory-extraction' on every recent issue; PAN-2383 has zero codex-origin events while slot-1 rollouts with model gpt-5.5 sit unswept on disk.

autoDecisions.summary: Codex sweep updates the existing cost_events row (keyed on source_file) when a rollout's cumulative totals grow.
autoDecisions.rationale: parseCodexSessionSync returns cumulative totals and codex events carry requestId=null, so insert-only dedup would freeze spend at first import; fresh requestIds per sweep would double-count.

autoDecisions.summary: codex-auto-review side threads stay recorded under their real model id at computed cost ($0 — no pricing entry).
autoDecisions.rationale: They are subscription-included auto-review threads; inventing gpt-5.5 pricing for them would fabricate spend. The non-zero acceptance applies to the primary gpt-5.5 rollout.

autoDecisions.summary: budget on /api/issues/:id/costs becomes undefined after the plane switch.
autoDecisions.rationale: No-loss audit: setIssueBudgetSync has no route caller and the frontend IssueCostData type has no budget field — the affordance is dead on this endpoint; overdeck budgets live in budgets.json via CostResolver.

items.title: Add no-issue attribution classifier + conversations-domain session lookup

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/costs/attribution.ts exporting: (a) const NO_ISSUE_BUCKETS = { conversations: 'CONVERSATIONS', flywheel: 'FLYWHEEL', unattributed: 'UNATTRIBUTED' } as const; (b) classifySessionBucket(input: { sessionId?: string | null; agentId?: string | null }, lookup: ConversationSessionLookup): string — returns FLYWHEEL when the matched conversation's name is 'flywheel-orchestrator', CONVERSATIONS for any other matched conversation, else UNATTRIBUTED. ConversationSessionLookup is an injected function type (sessionId/agentId in, { name: string } | null out) so tests need no DB. In src/lib/overdeck/conversations.ts (the conversations read door — it already owns conversation_files queries, see the raw-SQL join near line 789), add an exported sync helper findConversationForCostSessionSync(input: { sessionId?: string | null; agentId?: string | null }): { name: string } | null that matches (1) conversation_files.locator = sessionId, and (2) when agentId starts with 'conv-', conversations.tmux_session = agentId. Follow the file's existing drizzle/raw-SQL style via getOverdeckDatabaseSync. Unit-test the classifier with a fake lookup: conversation match => CONVERSATIONS; name 'flywheel-orchestrator' => FLYWHEEL; no match => UNATTRIBUTED; never returns the string 'UNKNOWN'.

items.title: Given a sessionId the lookup matches to a conversation named 'flywheel-orchestrator', classifySessionBucket returns 'FLYWHEEL'
Given a sessionId or 'conv-*' agentId the lookup matches to any other conversation, classifySessionBucket returns 'CONVERSATIONS'
Given no conversation match, classifySessionBucket returns 'UNATTRIBUTED' and never produces the string 'UNKNOWN'
findConversationForCostSessionSync returns the conversation name for a row seeded in conversation_files/conversations and null when absent
Reconciler classifies unmappable sessions into buckets instead of 'UNKNOWN'

expected_outputs: reconciler-buckets.test.ts passes and existing reconciler tests stay green

narrative.Action: In src/lib/costs/reconciler.ts, replace every `|| 'UNKNOWN'` fallback (four sites: buildSessionIndex line ~171, reconcilePiTranscripts line ~486, main transcript scan line ~615, subagents scan line ~666) with classifySessionBucket({ sessionId, agentId }, findConversationForCostSessionSync) from item attribution-classifier. Keep all existing successful attributions (state.json issueId, inferIssueId, pathIssueId) untouched — the classifier is only the final fallback where 'UNKNOWN' was. Thread the sessionId/agentId available at each site into the classifier. Add a unit test that injects a fake lookup and asserts extractCostEvents-fed events from an unmapped session carry 'CONVERSATIONS'/'FLYWHEEL'/'UNATTRIBUTED' (per lookup result) and that no code path in reconciler.ts can emit issueId 'UNKNOWN' (grep-style assertion or behavioral).

items.title: An unmapped session whose sessionId matches a registered conversation produces events with issueId 'CONVERSATIONS' (or 'FLYWHEEL' for flywheel-orchestrator)
An unmapped session with no conversation match produces events with issueId 'UNATTRIBUTED'

src/lib/costs/reconciler.ts no longer contains the literal fallback string 'UNKNOWN'
Idempotent backfill reclassifies existing UNKNOWN cost_events rows

expected_outputs: unknown-backfill.test.ts passes against a temp DB

narrative.Action: Add reclassifyUnknownCostEventsSync() (in src/lib/costs/attribution.ts, next to the classifier): SELECT DISTINCT session_id, agent_id FROM cost_events WHERE issue_id = 'UNKNOWN'; classify each pair via classifySessionBucket + findConversationForCostSessionSync; UPDATE cost_events SET issue_id = <bucket> WHERE issue_id = 'UNKNOWN' AND session_id IS <sid> AND agent_id IS <aid> (use IS to match NULLs). Every row is touched exactly once because the WHERE clause requires issue_id='UNKNOWN' — re-running is a no-op (idempotent). Return { updated: number }. Invoke it from runCostReconcileOnce in src/dashboard/server/services/cost-reconcile-service.ts after the transcript sweep, logging the updated count when > 0. Test against a temp sqlite DB (point OVERDECK_HOME/getOverdeckDatabaseSync at a temp dir the way existing overdeck DB tests do): seed UNKNOWN rows + conversation registry rows, run twice, assert all UNKNOWN rows became CONVERSATIONS/FLYWHEEL/UNATTRIBUTED, second run updates 0, and non-UNKNOWN rows (e.g. 'PAN-1') are untouched. Operational note for the work agent: before the first run against the real ~/.overdeck/overdeck.db, take the snapshot yourself (cp ~/.overdeck/overdeck.db to a timestamped file and verify byte size non-zero) — hazard H1 in continue.json.

items.title: One run against a seeded DB persists CONVERSATIONS, FLYWHEEL, or UNATTRIBUTED (per each session's conversation match) on every former UNKNOWN row, leaving zero rows with issue_id='UNKNOWN'
A second run returns { updated: 0 } and changes no rows (idempotent)
The backfill preserves rows whose issue_id is not exactly 'UNKNOWN' (real issues, 'sequencer-runner') byte-for-byte
runCostReconcileOnce invokes the backfill after the sweep and logs the updated count when non-zero
GET /api/issues/:id/costs reads the overdeck plane (single source with the Costs page)

narrative.Action: 1) In src/lib/overdeck/cost-sync.ts, extend getCostForIssueAggregateSync (line ~336) to also return providers: Record<string, number> via one grouped query (SELECT provider, SUM(cost) FROM cost_events WHERE UPPER(issue_id)=UPPER(?) GROUP BY provider; null provider keys as 'unknown'), mirroring getModelBreakdownForIssueSync's shape. Add the field to IssueAggregate. 2) In src/dashboard/server/routes/issues.ts, change getIssueCostsRoute (line ~690) to call getCostForIssueAggregateSync(id) from lib/overdeck/cost-sync.js instead of the legacy getCostsForIssueSync; delete the legacy import at line 62 if now unused (syncCacheSync may still have callers — remove only what this change orphans). No-loss audit — every current response key must survive with the same name and type: issueId, totalCost, resolvedTotalCost, aggregateCost, liveCost, totalTokens, inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheWriteTokens, models (with calls), providers, byModel, sessions (stays [] — the legacy read never populated it), byStage, budget (now always undefined per autoDecision — dead affordance, no consumer), budgetWarning, lastUpdated. resolveIssueHeadlineCost keeps receiving aggregateCost from the new plane. The null-issueData branch (totalCost: 0 fallback) keeps its shape for genuinely event-less issues.

The route response preserves every pre-change key (issueId, totalCost, resolvedTotalCost, aggregateCost, liveCost, totalTokens, token splits, models with calls, providers, byModel, sessions, byStage, budgetWarning, lastUpdated)

narrative.Action: 1) In src/dashboard/server/services/cost-reconcile-service.ts runCostReconcileOnce, after reconcilePiTranscripts(), run the codex sweep: Effect.runPromise(CostWriter.use(w => w.reconcile({ source: 'codex' })).pipe(Effect.provide(CostDoorLive))) (same import pattern as recordCostEventsThroughOverdeck in src/lib/costs/reconciler.ts:543-559); log imported count when > 0; catch and warn like the existing error handling. 2) In the codex branch of CostWriterLive.reconcile (src/lib/overdeck/cost.ts:589-613): (a) sessionType — read role from ~/.overdeck/agents/<agentName>/state.json (JSON.parse, field 'role', fallback 'work') instead of the literal source string; (b) update-on-growth — replace the checkDuplicate+record pair for codex events with: query the existing cost_events row by source_file; if none, record(event); if present and (input+output+cache_read) of the new cumulative totals is greater, UPDATE that row's input/output/cache_read/cost/model/session_type/ts via the drizzle q handle inside the writer (this stays inside the write door); if not greater, skip. Never insert a second row for the same source_file. 3) Test with a temp OVERDECK_HOME: write a minimal nested-schema rollout (session_meta + turn_context model gpt-5.5 + token_count) under agents/agent-pan-9999/codex-home/sessions/2026/07/05/, plus a state.json with role 'work'; run reconcile({source:'codex'}); assert one event with issueId PAN-9999, model gpt-5.5, cost > 0, sessionType 'work'; run again unchanged => imported 0 and still one row; append a larger token_count and re-run => same single row with the larger totals and higher cost. Repo rules: no execSync anywhere; if any test involves the 5-minute interval, use vi.useFakeTimers(). Readiness rationale: this item is dispatchable first because its only shared file (cost-reconcile-service.ts) is serialized by the blocks edge to unknown-backfill, which runs after it; all other edits are confined to the codex branch of cost.ts.
